---

### Verified Database Endpoints

* **Host:** `https://redoxyae.odoo.com`
* **Database Name:** `redoxyae`
* **Server Version:** `Odoo saas~19.3+e` (Enterprise)
* **Protocols:** XML-RPC (`/xmlrpc/2/common` & `/xmlrpc/2/object`) and JSON-RPC (`/jsonrpc`)

---

### Included Tools & Clients

1. **Web Hub**: [index.html](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/index.html) — Mobile-optimized interactive dashboard with credentials generator, API key creation guide, and schema reference.
2. **Python Client**: [odoo_client.py](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/odoo_client.py) — Zero-dependency client providing the [`OdooClient`](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/odoo_client.py#L35-L185) class with [`authenticate()`](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/odoo_client.py#L65-L95), [`search_read()`](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/odoo_client.py#L140-L155), `create()`, and `write()` methods.
3. **Connection Diagnostic**: [test_connection.py](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/test_connection.py) — CLI utility via [`test_connection()`](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/test_connection.py#L15-L115) to verify credentials and inspect database models.
4. **Quickstart Example**: [quickstart.py](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/quickstart.py) — Queries contacts (`res.partner`) and products (`product.template`).
5. **Node.js Client**: [odoo_client.js](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/odoo_client.js) — Native JSON-RPC client for JavaScript.
6. **Configuration**: [.env.example](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/.env.example) and documentation in [README.md](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/README.md).

---

### How to Connect & Authenticate

1. Get your API key from [redoxyae.odoo.com](https://redoxyae.odoo.com):
   * Tap your user avatar $\rightarrow$ **Preferences** / **My Profile** $\rightarrow$ **Account Security** tab $\rightarrow$ **New API Key**.
2. Run the connection test and save your credentials:
   ```bash
   python3 test_connection.py --user your-email@example.com --key YOUR_API_KEY --save
   ```
3. Run sample queries:
   ```bash
   python3 quickstart.py
   ```
